failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named field — the error carries the expected format. Generic buyers use TIN EI00000000010 (Malaysian public) or EI00000000020 (foreign).
failure_modes.when: the TIN fails the Malaysian format check or state_code is not an LHDN state code

description: Register a buyer in the LHDN buyer registry so it attaches to future e-invoices with one pick (customer_id) instead of typing the party every time. Validates the TIN format, and validates state_code against the LHDN state table when you send one — a buyer with no real TIN uses the LHDN generic TIN (EI00000000010 Malaysian public, EI00000000020 foreign) instead. NEXT: myinvois_invoice_generate with customer_id.
name: myinvois_customer_create
